menu.title: Foul Fowl 4X
menu.quit_confirm: This is the door. One More Turn is a different button, and it appears after you have already won.
credits.1: For eXplorminate, with affection: a small galaxy, a finished evening, and the swans exactly as guilty as charged.
credits.2: No balance patch was applied to the swans. This was a decision.
menu.preset.tiny.name: Tiny
menu.preset.evening_standard.name: Evening Standard
menu.preset.evening_standard.sub: Twenty-four stars. One sitting. Bedtime intact if you are honest.
menu.preset.evening_standard.seats: Swans, one early-war bird, one schemer. Take one of those seats and the chair refills.
menu.toggle.seat_swans.tip: Checked by default. Unchecking it is a setting.
difficulty.nestling.name: Nestling
difficulty.nestling.tip: The AI is smaller, and polite about it. It will not come for you first. The card says -25% industry and research.
difficulty.flighted.name: Flighted
difficulty.flighted.tip: No gifts to either side. If you lose, it is yours.
difficulty.honk_admiral.name: Honk Admiral
difficulty.honk_admiral.tip: The AI receives the printed bonuses and may read your ship designs. Be angry at a number. The number is listed.
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.name: Lights-Off Ledger
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.tip: +40% industry, +40% research, +20% growth, your designs, your colonies, your fleets. Every modifier is printed. None of them are gentle.
race.swans.name: The Pale Supremacy
race.swans.pitch: Better than you at the thing you were about to do, and already bored of the demonstration.
race.pheasants.name: The Ringneck Warrant
race.pheasants.pitch: A victory lap that learned to file flight plans.
race.ducks.name: The Dabble League
race.ducks.pitch: If it has a shoreline, they have a rate card.
race.geese.name: The Marked Airspace
race.geese.pitch: They were here first. The property line was the honk.
race.owls.name: The Night Parliament
race.owls.pitch: They have read the tree. They are waiting on you to finish the tutorial.
race.penguins.name: The Pebble Throne
race.penguins.pitch: They already colonized the iceball you filtered out.
race.crows.name: The Open Murder
race.crows.leader: Keeper of the Cache, Kestra Nightcache
race.crows.pitch: Your tech is in circulation. They are the circulation.
race.chickens.name: The Pecking Order
race.chickens.leader: Prime Rooster Cluckett of the Ninth
race.chickens.pitch: Someone has to build the galaxy. They voted, by pecking, that it would be them.
